verified_facts.text: The resort hotel overlooks a nature reserve and has easy beach access, in Barra da Tijuca.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our resort hotel overlooks a tranquil nature reserve, providing serene views, easy beach access, a refreshing on-site spa and pool and exceptional Rio restaurants.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is near Barra da Tijuca, an area known for its beach, shopping and urban attractions.
verified_facts.excerpt: explore the nearby Barra da Tijuca, one of Rio's most exclusive areas, known for its beach paradise, shopping and vibrant urban attractions

verified_facts.text: The rooms were designed by the international design studio Yabu Pushelberg, using native stones and exclusive fabrics.
verified_facts.excerpt: designed by the renowned international design studio Yabu Pushelberg, the rooms offer the perfect escape, inspired by local surroundings and incorporating native stones and exclusive fabrics

verified_facts.text: Every room and suite has a large private balcony.
verified_facts.excerpt: each with a large private balcony

verified_facts.text: Rooms look out to the Atlantic Ocean and to sunsets over the lagoon.
verified_facts.excerpt: Marvel at views of the Atlantic Ocean and breathtaking sunsets on the lagoon from the rooms at our Rio de Janeiro hotel.

verified_facts.text: Suites offer dining and living areas with landscaped terraces, and some have an infinity pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Upgrade to one of the 43 suites for enhanced features, including spacious dining and living areas with landscaped terraces or even an infinite pool.

verified_facts.text: Atiaia Spa has nine treatment suites, three of them for couples.
verified_facts.excerpt: Atiaia Spa has nine exclusive suites with three designated for couples

verified_facts.text: Atiaia means luminosity in Tupi-Guarani, one of Brazil's native languages.
verified_facts.excerpt: which means “luminosity” in one of Brazil’s native languages, Tupi-Guarani

verified_facts.text: The hotel has an outdoor pool with views of the surrounding area.
verified_facts.excerpt: Relax with a refreshing swim in our spectacular hotel pool with stunning views of the surrounding area.

verified_facts.text: The Grand Club Lounge has panoramic views of Praia da Barra and Lagoa de Marapendi.
verified_facts.excerpt: The space has panoramic views of Praia da Barra and Lagoa de Marapendi.

verified_facts.text: Grand Club guests get a breakfast buffet and an afternoon cocktail hour with appetizers.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests with access to the Grand Club service are entitled to a delicious breakfast buffet and an afternoon cocktail hour with various appetizers

verified_facts.text: Shiso is the hotel's Japanese restaurant, with an open kitchen, a sake bar and the Omakase Zen tasting menu.
verified_facts.excerpt: Explore our varied menu with diverse options and the Omakase Zen, a tasting menu featuring dishes selected by the chef. In addition, enjoy the sake bar

verified_facts.text: Cantô Gastrô & Lounge was designed by Arthur Casas and has a large mural inspired by Roberto Burle Marx.
verified_facts.excerpt: Designed by Arthur Casas, the restaurant offers a casual yet chic ambiance, featuring a large mural inspired by Roberto Burle Marx.

verified_facts.text: Tano, the breakfast restaurant designed by Arthur Casas, has views of Marapendi Lagoon.
verified_facts.excerpt: it was designed by Arthur Casas to integrate contemporary elements with the beautiful view of Marapendi Lagoon

verified_facts.text: The Kids Club has a ball pit, a trampoline, table football, a slide, video games and a baby area.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our Kids Club offers toys and activities like a ball pit, a trampoline, table football, a slide, video games, a baby area and much more.

verified_facts.text: The fitness center is open 24 hours and has a multifunctional studio with training sessions and yoga classes.
verified_facts.excerpt: Additionally, our large, multifunctional studio features training sessions and yoga classes.

verified_facts.text: Resort amenities include wellness and fitness activities and gastronomy workshops.
